purpose: Plan section 3 item: audit the restored v2 fields and production measurement sources; output the reuse/gap list for the AttachmentRecord contract; sim GT locked transforms must not register as measured sources.

VacuumCommandV2 (F18).behavior: attach freezes T_box_tool from the same-stamp measured box pose and the live TCP at the attach command (resolve_tool); release validates the measured final tool pose (admit_release); physics GT is never read into the record

GetCurrentBox.verdict: GT pull, reference only - 'measured rides the topic'. MUST NOT register as a measured attachment source. Eval/GT reference use stays allowed.

SyncPickupBox.behavior: backfills perception-measured geometry with CAS on generation; rejects non-measured height (height_valid)

SelectPlacePathV2 / BuildMotionSequenceV.verdict: carried over unchanged by C0; route/admission field gaps (if any appear during I) go through one typed-v2 extension with affected-endpoint inventory and refreshed proofs, per technical baseline section 2

measured_box_pose.source: perception-measured DetectedLuggage riding the current-box topic; drivers convert via detection_record_from_box and pass it as F18 measured_box (src/luggage_gazebo/scripts/pick_retreat_eval_driver.py:663-681)

tcp_at_attach.source: live TCP resolved at the attach command (resolve_tool), not the detection-stamp TCP (attachment_frame_adapters.py:94-99)

grasp_binding.source: captured at contact: live TCP versus the still-on-platform measured box (_frame_capture_grasp); optional against GRASP_TOLERANCE 0.01 m / 0.10 rad

sim_physics_lock.source: gazebo attach backend receives physical_relation + model_name (vacuum_backend.attach)
sim_physics_lock.verdict: physics-side only; the frozen record never contains it; allowed as simulation backend, never as a measured source

production_measurement_sources.conclusion: A production measured path exists today (perception topic + live TCP + F18 freeze). The attachment provider (D) wraps this path; no hard dependency on a future perception task is introduced.

attachment_record_gaps.status: gap (generation CAS is the box-measurement generation, not the attach event counter)

attachment_record_gaps.field: dimension axis semantics (fixed box axes, no re-sort)

attachment_record_gaps.owner: C0 (defined, default pi for rectangular cargo)

attachment_record_gaps.field: source kind + source method (measured_attach_confirmed / pre_attach_estimate / reference_sim_gt)
invalidation notification (slip / re-attach / frame change / expiry)
attachment_record_gaps.owner: D (provider), C (consumes for route invalidation), I (wires)

attachment_record_gaps.status: gap (freeze-time grasp tolerance exists; no in-carry re-observation check)

message_extension_decision: None required for C0: the ST09 contracts are ROS-free and carried in-repo; the provider and route/admission wiring stay inside existing v2 endpoints until I demonstrates a concrete field gap, at which point one typed-v2 extension with a rebuilt consumer set and refreshed proofs is mandatory (technical baseline section 2).
gt_registration_rule: Any record whose source resolves to the GetCurrentBox GT pull, a planned slot, a PCA yaw estimate, or the gazebo physics lock is rejected as ATTACHMENT_GT_AS_MEASURED / ATTACHMENT_SOURCE_UNQUALIFIED. Sim GT relative transforms may only enter REFERENCE_SIM_GT records used for offline verification.
